problems.problem: Prose: in “Rashi, on 24:67, reads it as Rebekah becoming like Sarah”, ‘it’ has no antecedent; the only thing named before the semicolon is Isaac meeting the caravan, which is not what Rashi comments on. His comment is on “האהלה שרה אמו” (into the tent, Sarah his mother), so the reader at six in the morning cannot tell what is being read.
problems.fix: Name the words Rashi reads (at most three of the key verse, in curly quotes), e.g. “Rashi, on 24:67, reads ‘Sarah’s tent’ as Rebekah becoming like Sarah, the lamp burning from Sabbath eve to Sabbath eve, the blessing in the dough and the cloud over the tent returning with her.” Rerun entry-check.js.

problems.problem: The reading goes beyond Rashi’s words: “reads the brothers’ discredit as their praise” says the discredit IS praise, but Rashi on 37:4 says “מתוך גנותם למדנו שבחם”, from their discredit we learn their praise; the hatred stays a discredit and the praise is inferred from it.
problems.fix: Keep his structure: “Rashi, on 37:4, finds within the brothers’ discredit their praise, that they did not say one thing with the mouth and another in the heart.” Rerun entry-check.js.
